guidance_q2fy27.src: Q1 FY27 release (8-K Item 2.02, Ex. 99.1, 31-Jul-2026), 'Outlook for the Second Quarter Fiscal 2027' and 'FY2027 Q2 Outlook - Modeling Items'
guidance_q2fy27.text: Net sales approximately $505.0 to $515.0 million in Q2 FY27 (vs $455.3 million, +10.9% to 13.1%); gross margin 45.5% to 45.75%; SG&A 16.5% to 16.75% of net sales. RBC guides one quarter ahead; no full-year guidance is published.

calendar.src: Q1 FY27 10-Q, MD&A overview: fiscal 2027 has 53 weeks (FY2026 52); Q1 FY27 and Q1 FY26 had 13 weeks

vacco.src: 8-K 21-Jul-2025 (Items 2.03 / 8.01: $275.0m cash, $200.0m revolver draw); 8-K 20-May-2025 Ex. 99.1 (agreement $310m; LTM revenue ~$118m to 31-Mar-2025); FY2026 10-K Note 21 (final allocation $276.7m; Section 338(h)(10) election); Q1 FY27 release ('$34.4 of net sales this quarter came from VACCO').

psc.src: 8-K 11-Aug-2026 Ex. 99.1: Dodge Industrial acquired the business assets of PSC Couplings, LLC (disc couplings, Richfield, WI) for $24.2m cash; LTM net sales ~$15.1m. Closed after the Q2 FY27 outlook (31-Jul-2026), so it is modelled on top of the guidance calibration.

dodge.src: FY2022 10-K Note 13 / FY2023 10-K (final purchase-price allocation, net assets $2,962.7m less cash $81.9m); financed with the $1,300m term loan, $500m 4.375% senior notes due 2029, common stock and 5.00% Series A MCPS offerings ($1,050.8m net) and cash.

debt.at_2026_06_27: Term loan $96.0m (matures 2-Nov-2026; $50.0m repaid after quarter end, $46.0m outstanding); revolver $200.0m drawn of $500.0m (expires Oct-2030; $3.7m letters of credit; $296.3m available); 4.375% senior notes $500.0m due 15-Oct-2029; Schaublin UBS line CHF 6.7m (~$8.3m, 2.00% fixed, to Apr-2036); finance leases. Balance sheet debt $806.2m (net of issuance costs). SOFR + 0.10% CSA + 0.75% margin; commitment fee 0.175% (Q1 FY27 10-Q Note 10).
debt.credit_8k: 8-K 30-Oct-2025: Second Amendment to the Credit Agreement extends the $500m revolver to 28-Oct-2030 and removes the interest-coverage covenant; term loan still matures 2-Nov-2026.

buyback: Q1 FY27 10-Q Part II Item 2: $100.0m repurchase authorization (2019, no expiry); no shares repurchased under it as of 27-Jun-2026. Repurchases shown are shares withheld from employees for tax on equity awards.
mcps: 5.00% Series A Mandatory Convertible Preferred Stock: 4,600,000 shares issued in fiscal 2022 (Dodge financing; dividends ~$5.75m a quarter); converted into common stock in October 2024 (FY2026 10-K Item 1A).
